17.name: You Can't Keep A Good Drag Queen Down!
17.overview: The Season 18 queens light up the Untucked Lounge for the first time. The queens waste no time before disagreeing over tops and bottoms. One queen’s top placement has everyone gagged.

17.name: Q-Pop Girl Groups
17.overview: The mood is darker in the Untucked Lounge after a shocker on the main stage. The divas try to uplift each other with a game of Truth or Dare. Sisterhood blooms in the Queen Cam booth.

17.name: RDR Live Returns!
17.overview: It’s a jungle in the Untucked Lounge and the claws are starting to come out. Tensions swirl around one queen who is rubbing her sisters the wrong way. Sarah Sherman and her mini-me stop by the lounge.

17.name: Red Carpet Mash-Ups
17.overview: After a jarring turn of events on the main stage, the queens are left stunned. They worry about the effect on tonight's elimination. The besties lighten the mood by strutting their stuff in the Untucked Lounge.

17.name: The Rate-A-Queen Talent Show, Part 1
17.overview: The voting queens have a lot to consider after Part One of the Rate-A-Queen Talent Show. One queen’s unsettling talent reveals an emotional story. Loyalties and alliances are solidified minutes before the queens cast their ballots.

17.name: The Rate-A-Queen Talent Show, Part 2
17.overview: The divas are tense after Part Two of the Rate-A-Queen Talent Show. New voting strategies have everyone on edge. The queens begin to realize that when it comes to staying in the competition, there are no rules!

17.name: Drag Queens For Change
17.overview: Everything is topsy-turvy in the Untucked Lounge as the queens struggle with losing the latest competitor. The queens prepare for what they know will be a tough elimination. Two unlikely friends bond over being underestimated by the other girls.

17.name: Snatch Game of Love: Island Edition
17.overview: The queens are ready to let off some steam after the Snatch Game of Love: Island Edition. A devious prank proves that you should never come between a queen and her snacks! Tears flow after a question on the main stage hits a nerve.

17.name: Fannie: The Hard Knock Ball Rusical
17.overview: The queens celebrate the breakthrough performances in the Rusical. Horoscope predictions are discussed over chocolate fondue. As the queens grow closer, eliminations have become more and more heartbreaking.

17.name: Drag in a Bag
17.overview: The vibe in the lounge is tense as one queen struggles to make sense of how her sisters really feel about her. Bruno delivers a treat that lightens the mood. Legendary supermodel Iman shares iconic lessons from her amazing life and career.

17.name: A Toast to Alyssa Edwards
17.overview: Alyssa Edwards takes over the Untucked lounge for a hilarious and heartfelt visit. One queen basks in the afterglow of a surprisingly good performance in the Roast. An emotional critique has another queen evaluating her place in the competition.

17.name: Mammas, Don’t Let Your Babies Grow Up to Be Drag Queens
17.overview: After the makeover challenge, it’s time to rustle up some fun in the Untucked Lounge! The queens and the cowboys bond over their meaningful experience. Even with the end in sight, it’s still unclear who will make it to the finale.

17.name: Karens Gone Wild
17.overview: A somber mood permeates the lounge as the queens process a variety of emotions. One queen is left reeling after the judges' critiques.

17.name: Good Morning Bitches
17.overview: The queens gather in the Untucked lounge for the final time and celebrate making it this far in the competition. The mood is bittersweet, knowing that whatever happens tonight determines who goes to the Grand Finale.

overview: The access-all-areas pass to the drama that you didn't see on the runway—the backstage bitchiness, the catfights, the struggles, the tears and the secrets. See what happens behind the scenes of RuPaul's Drag Race when the queens let their tucks breathe... and let their emotions flow.
